```{r Integration}

#Individual dataset integration Extended Fig.2 and Extended Fig.8 

plan("multiprocess", workers = 4)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 16000 * 1024^2)
gc()

nuclei.appended <- list(nuclei_1, nuclei_2, nuclei_3, nuclei_4, nuclei_5, nuclei_6) # load the individual sample objects per dataset and create a list as created in the step 01_preprocessing
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = nuclei.appended, nfeatures = 3000, verbose = F)
nuclei.appended <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = nuclei.appended, anchor.features = features, verbose = T)
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = nuclei.appended, dims = 1:30, anchor.features = features, normalization.method = "SCT", reduction = "rpca", verbose = T)

plan("multiprocess", workers = 1) 
gc()

nuclei <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, dims = 1:30, normalization.method = "SCT")
nuclei <- RunPCA(nuclei, verbose = T)
nuclei <- RunUMAP(nuclei, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30, verbose = T)
nuclei <- FindNeighbors(nuclei, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
nuclei <- FindClusters(nuclei, resolution = 0.25)

DimPlot(nuclei, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident")
View(nuclei)

saveRDS(nuclei, file = "Dataset_integrated_nuclei.RDS") 

```

```{r Clustering assessment}

#assess clustering resolution with clustree and choose a stable res parameter 
resolution.range <- seq(from = 0.1, to = 1, by = 0.1)
DefaultAssay(nuclei) <-  "integrated"
Graphs(nuclei)
Clustree <- Seurat::FindClusters(object = nuclei, resolution = resolution.range)
clustree(Clustree, prefix = "integrated_snn_res.")

# assess cluster tree for cluster merging 
nuclei <- BuildClusterTree( object = nuclei, assay = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:30, reorder = T)
tree <- Tool(object = nuclei, slot = 'BuildClusterTree')
ape_1 <- PlotClusterTree(object = tree, direction = "downwards")
ape_1

```

```{r }

#Dataset integration Main Fig.2

DefaultAssay(object = nuclei) <- "RNA"       # adult dataset object
DefaultAssay(object = MI_nuclei) <- "RNA"    # MI dataset object
DefaultAssay(object = juv_nuclei) <- "RNA"   # juvenile dataset object

nuclei[['integrated']] <- NULL
MI_nuclei[['integrated']] <- NULL
juv_nuclei[['integrated']] <- NULL

MI_nuclei[['SCT']] <- NULL
juv_nuclei[['SCT']] <- NULL
nuclei[['SCT']] <- NULL

View(nuclei)

#split RNA assay

nuclei <- SplitObject(object = nuclei, split.by = "orig.ident")
MI_nuclei <- SplitObject(object = MI_nuclei, split.by = "orig.ident")
juv_nuclei <- SplitObject(object = juv_nuclei, split.by = "orig.ident")

nuclei.appended <- list(nuclei, MI_nuclei, juv_nuclei) 
nuclei.appended <- unlist(nuclei.appended, recursive=FALSE)

rm(nuclei, MI_nuclei, juv_nuclei)
gc()

nuclei <- merge(x= nuclei.appended[[1]], y = nuclei.appended[-1])

nuclei[["RNA"]] <- split(nuclei[["RNA"]], f = nuclei$orig.ident)
Layers(nuclei[["RNA"]])

nuclei <- NormalizeData(nuclei, verbose = T)
nuclei <- FindVariableFeatures(nuclei, verbose = T)
nuclei <- ScaleData(nuclei, verbose = T)
nuclei <- RunPCA(nuclei, verbose = T)
gc()


nuclei <- IntegrateLayers(object = nuclei, method = RPCAIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",  verbose = T) 

nuclei <- FindNeighbors(nuclei, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:30)
nuclei <- FindClusters(nuclei, resolution = 0.5)
nuclei <- RunUMAP(nuclei, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.rpca", return.model = T, verbose = T)

nuclei <- JoinLayers(nuclei)   # now that integration is complete, rejoin layers

p1 <- DimPlot(
  nuclei,
  reduction = "umap.rpca",
  group.by = "orig.ident"
)

p1

saveRDS(nuclei, file = "ALL_nuclei_integrated_RNALayer.RDS")

View(nuclei)

```

```{r 3D UMAP}

library(plotly)

Idents(nuclei) <- "annot"
nuclei@active.ident <- factor(nuclei@active.ident, 
                            levels=c("adipocytes", "cardiac.glial", "cardiomyocytes", "cardiomyocytes.atria", "endocardial", "endothelial", "epicardial", "fibroblasts", "lymphocytes", "myeloid", "lymphatic", "pericytes", "smooth.muscle"))

nuclei <- RunUMAP(nuclei, reduction = "integrated.rpca",
                            dims = 1:30,
                            n.components = 3L, return.model = T, verbose = T, reduction.name = "umap")

head(Embeddings(object = nuclei, reduction = "umap"))

plot.data_annot <- FetchData(object = nuclei, vars = c("umap_1", "umap_2", "umap_3", "annot")) 
plot.data_annot$label <- paste(rownames(plot.data_annot))

fig_annot <- plot_ly(data = plot.data_annot, 
        x = ~umap_1, y = ~umap_2, z = ~umap_3, 
        color = ~annot, 
        colors = c( "#8CE7E8", "#8D6CB6", "#DD3721", "#F0A6CF",  "#262A81", "#5082F5", "#78DA46", "#F3E54E",  "#A9A7FF", "#BB33B1", "#FFAF79", "#D0FB53",  "#B5C7E3" ),
        type = "scatter3d", 
        mode = "markers", 
        marker = list(size = 0.5, width=2),
        text=~annot, 
        hoverinfo="text") 

axx <- list(
  nticks = 4,
  range = c(-10,10))
axy <- list(
  nticks = 4,
  range = c(-10,10))
axz <- list(
  nticks = 4,
  range = c(-10,10))

fig_annot <- fig_annot %>% layout(scene = list(xaxis=axx,yaxis=axy,zaxis=axz, aspectmode='cube'))
fig_annot

```

```{r cell percentage plots}

tab <- table(nuclei$orig.ident,nuclei$annot)
tab <- tab/rowSums(tab)*100
m <- melt(tab)
png("Cell_Percentage_CombinedBargraph.png",width = 433,height = 433,res=120)
ggplot(m,aes(x=Var1,fill=Var2,y=value))+geom_bar(stat="identity",width = .8)+theme_classic(base_size = 8)+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust=1,angle = 45))+xlab("")+ylab("% of total cells")+theme(legend.key.size = unit(.3,"cm"),legend.text = element_text(size=8))
dev.off()
```
